entry.title: Updated: dsh-egress-guard
entry.summary: Runtime security gate on the tool pipeline: denies calls naming hosts outside an egress allowlist, redacts credentials from results at the canonical value rather than only the rendered content, and appends every decision to a JSONL audit log; ships in monitor-only mode. Exact install spec: github:tancheng33/dsh-egress-guard. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
